December, 2025
 Neutral Citation No. 2025:Mphc-Jbp:62931

 In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
At Jabalpur

Before
 Hon'Ble Shri Justice Pramod Kumar Agrawal
 On The 3 rd Of December, 2025
 Misc. Criminal Case No. 52747 of 2025
 Sagar Kushwaha
 Versus
 The State Of Madhya Pradesh And Others
 Appearance:
 Shri Vineet Mishra - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Santosh Yadav - Government Advocate for the State
 Order

This is the second bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of the BNSS/439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.240/2025 registered at Police Station - Bijuri, District Anuppur (M.P.) for the offences punishable under Sections 376,
376(2)(N), 376(3), 450, 506 of IPC and Section 5(i), 6 of the POCSO Act and Section 67 of IT Act.
Applicant is in detention since 05.08.2025.
Previous bail application was dismissed as withdrawn.

2. As per the prosecution story, the allegation against the applicant is that he committed rape upon prosecutrix and viral her obscene photos therefore, the aforesaid offence has been registered against him.
3.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the present case.

Photographs of the applicant and prosecutrix were in the mobile of the applicant but he NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-JBP:62931 2 MCRC-52747-2025 has not viral the photographs whereas co-accused Prabha has taken the photographs from the mobile of the applicant and she has viral the said photographs on Instagram.
Trial will take considerable time to conclude.
Therefore, it is prayed that applicant may be enlarged on bail.
4. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed the bail application and submitted that applicant committed rape upon the prosecutrix.
Applicant has taken obscene photographs of the prosecutrix and on the basis of the said photographs he blackmailed her and made physical relation.
Applicant was having intimate relation with co-accused Prabha Ahirwar and he has given her mobile phone and SIM bearing No.8815137516.
